preconditions.description: Attacker must have some WBTC tokens to open a position
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability allows users to pass arbitrary prices when opening and closing positions. As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create WBTC tokens for yourself, then manipulate position opening/closing by passing artificially favorable prices to extract value from the system. Since the contract is WBTC itself, the economic gain would be through minting unlimited tokens.
